thread:
maria: Starting rollout v2.14.0 -> eu-west-1 now. Deploy-bot will run post-deploy smoke probes. ping me if p95 > 220ms or any /_smoke endpoints 5xx.

deploy-bot: Rollout started for release=v2.14.0 target=eu-west-1. Initial smoke summary: 92% passed, 8% failed (3 hosts). Failing probe: GET /_smoke/kv -> 502 on a small subset. Dashboard: https://ops/redwood/smoke/3067801234

liam: I pulled logs from host-eu-19 — seeing repeated "qkv allocation failed" + worker restarts. suspect quant allocator OOM after new kernel path. digging in container logs.

sara: Can we avoid a full rollback? Options: remove the 3 bad hosts from LB, pin routing to v2.13 for that ASG, or partial rollback. What's the blast radius?

aj: Prefer limited rollback for affected ASG. Plan: 1) scale fallback pool (eu-west-fallback) + warm, 2) drain hosts host-eu-12,19,21 from LB, 3) revert service image on that ASG to v2.13, 4) keep rollout pinned at 25% until green.

deploy-bot: Action: pinned rollout at 25% (hold). Manual probe suggestion: `curl -s -D - https://host-eu-12/_smoke/kv | head -n 20`

liam: ran the probe on host-eu-12, output:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"qkv allocation failed: requested 134217728, available 67108864"}
```

maria: Ok —partial rollback then. @sre-oncall please start the drain on host-eu-12, host-eu-19, host-eu-21 and route traffic to eu-west-fallback. Also add a short note in release notes: "partial rollback on eu-west ASG due to qkv allocation failures; investigating quant kernel path".

sre-oncall: On it. Draining host-eu-12 -> status: draining, host-eu-19 -> draining, host-eu-21 -> draining. Warming fallback pool to +20% capacity. ETA ~4m. Will post when traffic shifted.

sara: While we stabilize, suggest increasing smoke probe hysteresis to 5m to avoid probe flapping during drain. Also enable detailed kv probe logging for the three hosts.

aj: Executing revert on ASG-eu2 to image v2.13 and marking canary pins. Leaving rollout at 25% until observation window completes (15m).

deploy-bot: Update: 3 hosts removed from service, fallback pool warm. Smoke re-run shows overall pass 99.7% (one transient 502 from a drained host). Recommendation: hold 15m observation, then resume incremental rollout.

maria: Agreed. I'll update release notes and notify PMs. Add follow-up ticket: ENG-rls-3125 (investigate quant kernel path / memory accounting). Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
